answer: Divergent-History Fee: each identity commits a crystal of its action log hash at registration. Clones share identical histories, so when two identities submit the same crystal within one epoch, both are flagged and charged. An honest agent diverges naturally via unique timing and ordering. Attackers must pay a quartz toll per clone to fork histories plus opal renewal for each fork; cloning N identities costs N divergent-log fees, not one shared registration.
